problem_statement: We help companies run fast, cost-effective market research using synthetic personas. Our platform generates AI-simulated focus groups and pricing surveys that replicate real customer feedback in minutes, not weeks. Companies can test messaging, positioning, and pricing with 2 to 80 personas, reducing cost by up to 99% and improving research accuracy compared to traditional methods.
